Streetlights flicker on one by one across the sprawling grid below, tiny golden sparks mimicking the fading warmth above. The air softens, the noise of the day settling into a low, reflective hum as the last sliver of sun disappears behind the buildings, leaving the clouds smoldering at their edges like the remnants of a dying fire.
